races.paceDynamic: Fitzella and Hassaleh will ensure a strong early gallop from the gates, with both natural front-runners likely to dispute the early lead over this sharp 6f trip. Hollywood Treasure and Soul Love should sit prominently behind the pace-setters, while the hold-up horses Zooming, Flowerhead, Princess Petrol and Starfinch will need to rely on the strong pace to set up their finishing kicks. The dual pace angle creates an honest gallop that should favour horses with tactical speed who can position prominently and kick, rather than pure front-runners or horses needing excessive pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front-runners duel hard
scenarios.trigger: If Fitzella and Hassaleh engage in a sustained speed duel through fractions.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable for the leaders, setting up perfect conditions for horses with finishing kicks positioned in midfield. Hold-up specialists get the strong pace they need to unleash late rallies.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If one front-runner backs down quickly, leaving the other in control.
scenarios.body: The remaining leader gets soft fractions and proves hard to peg back in the final furlong. Prominent racers who can stay close enough benefit most from the tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but sustainable for well-positioned horses.
scenarios.body: Those sitting in the box seat behind the leaders can time their challenges perfectly without relying on a collapse. The race becomes about tactical positioning rather than extreme pace scenarios.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy pace unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go too slow early then sprint home.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace compromises closers while favouring horses with natural gate speed who can adapt. Class and raw ability become more important than tactical positioning.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Fitzella and Hassaleh both show early speed - a genuine speed duel could set up the race for closers
Monitor Hollywood Treasure's fitness levels after the long layoff, especially in the final furlong
Observe how quickly the pace develops in the first two furlongs as this will determine tactical positioning

Check if Princess Petrol can overcome her disappointing last-time-out effort with better tactical placement

races.paceDynamic: Shes Perfect will lead from the gate with Blue Bolt tracking in second, creating a measured gallop that won't stretch either prominent runner early. The four hold-up horses (Never Let Go, Kon Tiki, Arisaig, Betty Clover) will be bunched behind this sedate pace, setting up a sprint finish. With no pace pressure on the leaders and multiple closers needing the same racing room, this sustainable tempo strongly favours the front two who can dictate terms. This race shape clearly benefits prominent runners who can avoid the traffic and kick clear when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Two Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Shes Perfect and Blue Bolt establish a comfortable lead without pressure from behind
scenarios.body: The pace-setters control the race completely and one kicks clear in the straight while the hold-up horses struggle for racing room. Blue Bolt's superior form figures give her the edge in a head-to-head with the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Blue Bolt Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Bolt takes the lead from Shes Perfect approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: Colin Keane's mount uses her class advantage to dominate from the front, while the closers leave their runs too late on the sustained gallop. Her recent excellent form at similar trips makes her the controlling force.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly in the final three furlongs creating gaps for closers
scenarios.body: Never Let Go gets the perfect stalking trip and produces her best effort, while Arisaig's consistency at Goodwood pays dividends. The front two pay for their early efforts as the tempo finally tells.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders tire dramatically and multiple closers charge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop becomes unsustainable and creates a cavalry charge finish where any of the four hold-up horses can prevail. Class becomes secondary to who gets the clearest run in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Blue Bolt's market position will reveal connections' confidence after her 210-day absence
Shes Perfect may go too fast early if she doesn't settle, compromising her stamina reserves
Never Let Go needs to be positioned closer than usual if the pace stays pedestrian
The hold-up quartet could get bunched turning for home if the gallop stays too steady

races.paceDynamic: Aggagio will take the race forward as the only confirmed front runner, likely getting an uncontested lead through the early stages. With six hold-up horses behind him, there's minimal early pace pressure, allowing Aggagio to dictate comfortable fractions over the extended 2m trip. The real action begins when the hold-up brigade - led by in-form Percy Shelley and returning Novelista - attempt their finishing kicks from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as they'll benefit from the modest early gallop and have tactical positioning advantages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Aggagio sets modest fractions and the hold-up horses time their runs perfectly
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay dividends as horses like Percy Shelley and Novelista sweep past a tiring leader with superior finishing kicks. The slow early pace becomes a sprint finish that suits the class horses coming from behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner kicks clear
scenarios.trigger: If Aggagio maintains strong gallop and hold-up horses leave it too late
scenarios.body: Aggagio's uncontested lead allows him to build an unassailable advantage, with the hold-up horses failing to make up the deficit despite their late surge. His prominent style proves ideal for exploiting the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improved Arc Zoosve strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Arc Zoosve shows dramatic improvement from his recent winning form
scenarios.body: The Neil King runner continues his upward trajectory and times his challenge perfectly from the back. His recent victories suggest untapped potential that could surprise at bigger odds.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Aggagio goes too slow and multiple horses finish together
scenarios.body: The modest early pace creates a blanket finish where any of the hold-up horses could prevail in a lottery-style conclusion. Form and class become less relevant in the final scramble.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Aggagio getting too easy a lead early - if uncontested through half-mile he could steal a decisive advantage
Monitor Percy Shelley's position turning for home - if Cieren Fallon has him perfectly placed he looks the most likely winner

Watch Arc Zoosve's jumping from the stalls - his hold-up style requires good early positioning to be effective from the back

races.paceDynamic: Tiger Tulip and Tanjen will dispute the early lead in this 5f sprint, with both confirmed front-runners likely to ensure a solid gallop from the gates. The pace should be honest rather than frantic given only two dedicated leaders, creating a tactical race where positioning will be crucial. With most of the field comprising hold-up horses (The Thames Boatman, Spring Bloom, Serenity Dream, Sandscreendeliverd, Rory Rocket), the tempo may not be strong enough to set up the perfect closer's finish. This race shape favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can sit close to the pace without being caught in early speed battles.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained pace favours closers
scenarios.trigger: If Tiger Tulip and Tanjen engage in a genuine speed duel from the start
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will stretch the field and create perfect conditions for the hold-up brigade to sweep past tiring leaders. The Thames Boatman and Sandscreendeliverd can utilise their finishing kicks effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical affair suits handy horses
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders settle into a working gallop without killing each other
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows prominent runners to track the leaders closely and strike when it matters most in the final furlong. Solvency and Faustus benefit from being able to sit handy without cover problems.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner steals march
scenarios.trigger: If one of Tiger Tulip or Tanjen gets an uncontested lead while the other is slow away
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate terms and kick clear before the closers can mount their challenge over this minimum trip. Tiger Tulip's superior class gives him the edge in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Tiger Tulip and Tanjen are reluctant to commit early and the pace becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can prevail regardless of their usual running style. Form and class become secondary to who gets the clearest run.

races.paceDynamic: Lord Melbourne is the sole confirmed front-runner but races prominently rather than leading wire-to-wire, suggesting a measured early tempo. Love Beach and Urban Glimpse will likely sit just behind in second/third, with Samuel Colt also forward but not pressing. The large hold-up brigade of Majestic, Circus Of Rome, Yabher, Alpha Crucis, Too Soon, Al Aali and City Of Delight will create significant late traffic problems in a relatively modest field. This sustainable pace followed by a cavalry charge finish heavily favours horses with tactical speed who can position closer to the pace and avoid the late scrimmaging.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Melbourne sets steady fractions without pressure from the hold-up brigade
scenarios.body: The measured pace allows prominent runners to quicken clear before the backmarkers can organize their challenges. Love Beach and Urban Glimpse benefit from their forward positions while the hold-up horses get tangled in traffic.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The field compresses into a sprint finish where pure class tells and one hold-up horse with the right draw gets a clear run. Yabher or Circus Of Rome use their superior recent form to strike late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lord Melbourne Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Melbourne kicks clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: His prominent style becomes more aggressive and he steals a march while the hold-up horses are still organizing. Recent winners suggest he has the tactical nous to time his move perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses get severely hampered in running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where positioning trumps ability and an unfancied runner benefits from a clear passage. Too Soon or Al Aali could profit from the mayhem.

scenarios.label: A
